🕸️ Welcome to Raise a Spider Fighter! 🕸️
🥚 Hatch • 💪 Raise • ⚔️ Battle • 🧬 Fuse • 🧪 Mutate

🚧 BETA: The game is still in beta! Expect bugs and lots of new updates. Report bugs in the group!

🎁 CODE: UPD1

🪵 Battle on the STICK and climb the duel stages!
🐦 Team up to defeat world BOSSES in the pit!
🐞 Catch bugs in the PIT and sell them for coins!
🔍 Explore the wild and reveal MYSTERY spiders. Will yours be a Secret?
🥚 Hatch eggs to collect rare & exotic spiders!
🧬 Fuse spiders and mutate them into terrifying beasts!
⚡ Unleash anime abilities to annihilate enemies!
🏆 Climb the RANKS in rank battles!
🌟 Rebirth to multiply earnings and unlock new biomes!

💤 OFFLINE: Your spiders lay eggs and work even while you're offline!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new updates!
👥 Join the group for free perks!
🔔 Follow to catch new codes first!
